tagline: Unlocking the infinite potential of aluminum to advance a world free from waste
hero_kpi_rationale: The beverage packaging segment represents more than 95% of revenue, and its marginal evolution is the primary driver of operational performance following the divestiture of aerospace.

kpis.explanation: Total company sales after deduction of returns and discounts.
kpis.description: Revenue increased by 11.6% in 2025, driven by volume growth, price mix, and currency translation.
kpis.signal: Double-digit growth driven by volume and pricing.

kpis.explanation: Difference between sales and cost of goods sold, excluding depreciation.
kpis.description: Gross margin declined from 21% to 20% due to higher raw material costs, particularly aluminum.
kpis.signal: Margin compression linked to rising raw material costs.

kpis.description: Calculated from adjusted operating income and sales ($13,161M), operating margin remains resilient.
kpis.signal: Stable operating margin despite cost volatility.

kpis.explanation: Expenditures for the acquisition or modernization of physical assets.
kpis.description: Capex amounts to $800M in 2025, slightly higher, aligned with expansion and optimization strategy.
kpis.signal: Capex increase to support capacity and efficiency.

kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: Total headcount decreased to 17,500 in 2025, following the exit from the aerospace business.

kpis.explanation: Measure of the profitability of capital invested by the company.
kpis.description: ROIC improved due to stronger cash flow generation and disciplined asset management.
kpis.signal: Improved capital efficiency through financial discipline.

kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating margin of combined beverage packaging segments.
kpis.description: Combined EBIT margin across the three beverage segments (NA 12%, EMEA 12%, SA 15%) increased from 12.5% to 13.5% in 2025, driven by volume growth and cost optimization.
kpis.signal: Improved operational performance across all three regions.

kpis.explanation: Increase in volumes of aluminum packaging sold.
kpis.description: Volumes increased by 8.5% in 2025, driven by the shift toward aluminum in beverages and the acquisition of Florida Can Manufacturing.
kpis.signal: Strong demand momentum for aluminum cans.

risks.title: High Debt
risks.score_rationale: The company has significant debt of $7.01 billion, which could limit financial flexibility and increase vulnerability to adverse economic developments.

risks.title: Intense Competition
risks.score_rationale: Competition in the packaging industry is intense, with competitors possessing superior financial and technical resources.

risks.title: Demand Dependency
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on demand for its products, particularly beverage containers, which could be affected by market fluctuations.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to fluctuations in exchange rates, which could impact its financial results.

risks.title: Supply Chain Disruptions
risks.score_rationale: The company is vulnerable to supply chain disruptions, which could impact its financial results.

risks.title: Goodwill Impairment
risks.score_rationale: The company holds a significant amount of goodwill, which could be affected by market fluctuations.

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations, which could impact its financial results.

ai_positioning.summary: The company Ball does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
